graph.title: Bar Graph (10 LEDs controlled by a potentiometer)

parts.label: Uno GND to top ground rail

notes: Each LED sits in a column on the breadboard half that the image draws at the top (bank 'b', rows f-j). Its anode (bent leg) is in that column, and its cathode goes to the top ground rail. Each 220 ohm resistor bridges the centre gap in the same column to the bank 't' strip, where the Uno signal wire lands. The resistor is therefore on the anode side, in series between the Uno pin and the LED.
LED k uses breadboard column 2k+2 and is driven from Uno pin 12-k (pins 11 down to 2).
The exact rail hole numbers (tn.2, tn.5 ... tn.26) and row letters are estimated from the image. They all fall on the same rail strip or column strip, so the electrical connectivity is the same.

The potentiometer is placed across the gap: GND and VCC in the bank 't' strips of columns 28 and 30, and the wiper (SIG) in the bank 'b' strip of column 29. The black wire from the ground rail goes to the GND column, the red 5V wire to the VCC column, and the yellow A0 wire to the wiper column.
The Uno GND used is the one in the digital header next to pin 13 (GND.1).
